name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Neutral-Grip Wrist Curl
steps: Rest one forearm on the bench with your hand past the edge and hold the dumbbell thumb-side up.
Allow your hand to tilt downward smoothly toward the floor to stretch the side of your wrist.
Lift the thumb side of your hand toward your forearm while your elbow stays still.
Lower the dumbbell slowly back to the start, and switch sides after completing one arm.
tips: Keep your forearm anchored on the bench so your elbow does not lift during the curl.
Move through a controlled range of motion without jerking your wrist.
